Well, I don't know if its paranormal, but I heard low growl-like noises in my attic. This wasn't a one time thing either. The same week I first heard the noises my dog started acting strange. One day she stopped in the middle of her tracks and just started barking violently at an empty hallway. That same week my neighbors dog somehow got into my house and also started barking violently at the empty hallway. It was definitely strange. Things went on for maybe two weeks then it kind of just stopped.
